email.description: Account email; doubles as the login name and verification target.

password.description: Account password. Policy: at least 8 characters with letters and digits, and it must not contain the email.

role.description: Self-service roles only. Staff roles (INSTRUCTOR, ADMIN) are created by an admin through the backoffice.

fullName.description: Full display name of the account holder.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth (ISO 8601 date). Minors are registered by the club, never self-serve.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by login / mfa login-verify / refresh-token. Rotated on every use.

token.description: Email verification token from the verification link (valid 24 hours).

email.description: Account email the mail should be sent to.

token.description: Password reset token from the email link (valid 15 minutes).

password.description: New password. Policy: at least 8 characters with letters and digits.

newPassword.description: Replacement password (policy-validated). Revokes all other sessions.

code.description: Current TOTP code; required when MFA is enabled on the account.

newEmail.description: New email address. The change only applies after the emailed confirmation token is used.

token.description: Email-change confirmation token from the email sent to the NEW address.

password.description: Current password (re-authentication for a sensitive operation).

code.description: Current TOTP code; required when MFA is enabled on the account.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived mfaToken returned by POST /auth/login when mfaRequired is true.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app (or an 8-character recovery code where accepted).
Current TOTP code from the authenticator app.

password.description: Initial password (policy-validated). The admin hands it to the user out of band.

role.description: Role of the new account; creating INSTRUCTOR/ADMIN accounts is the supported staff path.

fullName.description: Optional display name stored on the linked student profile, not on the account.

role.description: New role. Changing it revokes all sessions and bumps the password version immediately.

isActive.description: Deactivating (false) revokes all sessions; reactivation does not restore them.

newPassword.description: Admin-set replacement password (policy-validated); revokes all sessions.

unitAmount.description: Unit price in VND (integer). Each quantity × unitAmount and the invoice subtotal must not exceed 2147483647 VND; exceeding either bound returns 400.

studentId.description: StudentProfile id the invoice is issued to.

type.description: Invoice type. TUITION requires periodMonth/periodYear and is idempotent per (student, period); other types forbid them.

items.description: Line items (1..50). The sum of line amounts must not exceed 2147483647 VND.

discount.description: Manual discount in VND; total = subtotal − discount − code discount; total ≥ 0.

dueDate.description: Payment due date (ISO 8601); defaults to 14 days from now.

note.description: Free-text note shown on the invoice.

periodMonth.description: Billing period month (1..12); required for TUITION, forbidden otherwise.

periodYear.description: Billing period year (2000..2100); required for TUITION, forbidden otherwise.

discountCode.description: Active discount code resolved at creation time; its discount is added to any manual discount.

classIds.description: Classes to close tuition for; every class needs a configured tuition rate.

classId.description: Class id the rate applies to (must exist).

rates.description: Replaces the whole stored tuition_rates map; unknown class ids are rejected and duplicates within the list fail.

name.example: CONG TY TNHH VOVINAM ANH QUAN

ownerType.description: Plan section 10: fee collection only through the legal entity account (BUSINESS).

bankAccount.description: Receiving account for QR payments; must be the legal entity account.

code.description: Code customers quote (unique, case-insensitive; stored uppercase).

percentOff.description: Percent discount (1..100). Set exactly ONE of percentOff/amountOff.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount in VND (integer ≥ 1000). Set exactly ONE of percentOff/amountOff.

validUntil.description: Last valid moment (ISO 8601 date-time); must be after validFrom.

isActive.description: Deactivate without deleting; inactive codes are refused at invoice time.

note.description: Note recorded with the cash payment (who paid, receipt number, ...).

status.description: REFUNDED records an externally completed refund; this API does not initiate a bank transfer. SUCCESS or DISPUTED receipts may be refunded. Only SUCCESS receipts may be marked DISPUTED.

note.description: Reason recorded in the audit trail.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes visible to instructors for safety.
Medical notes the instructors must know (injuries, asthma, ...). Shown to instructors for safety.
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds; omit for an unranked beginner.

linkedUserEmail.description: Links the profile to an existing verified STUDENT account (e.g. an adult self-registration awaiting approval). The account must have no profile yet.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes the instructors must know (injuries, asthma, ...).
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds.

status.description: Lifecycle status. PENDING = awaiting club approval, ACTIVE = training, PAUSED = temporarily away, LEFT = departed.

instructorId.description: User id of the assigned instructor; must be an active user with the INSTRUCTOR role.

capacity.description: Maximum number of simultaneously active enrollments (1..500).

instructorId.description: User id of the new instructor (must have the INSTRUCTOR role).

capacity.description: New capacity; cannot be lower than the current number of active enrollments.

status.description: Lifecycle status. PAUSED/ARCHIVED block new sessions and enrollments; history stays readable.

weekday.description: Day of week, 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday (Postgres DOW convention).

endTime.description: End time HH:MM (24h); must be after the start time.

effectiveFrom.description: First date the slot applies (ISO 8601 date).

effectiveTo.description: Last date the slot applies; omit for an open-ended slot.

studentId.description: StudentProfile id to enroll (must be an ACTIVE profile).

classId.description: Class id to enroll into (must be an ACTIVE class with free capacity).
Class the session belongs to; you must manage that class.

sessionDate.description: Calendar date of the session; one session per class per date (unique).

studentId.description: StudentProfile id; must be currently enrolled in the session class.

status.description: Attendance status for the student in this session.

records.description: One entry per student; each student may appear once, all entries must be enrolled in the class, and the whole batch applies atomically.

code.description: Club code, e.g. LAM_1, VANG_2, DO_6 (unique).

orderIndex.description: Global ordering across all groups; promotion always targets a higher order.

isActive.description: Deactivated ranks cannot be targets of exams or proposals.

code.description: Human-readable exam code (e.g. EXAM-2026-03); generated as EXAM-<year>-NN when omitted.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

targetRankId.description: BeltRank id the exam promotes to (must be an active rank).

capacity.description: Maximum number of active registrations; omit for unbounded.

registrationDeadline.description: Registration deadline (ISO 8601); must not be after the exam date. Later registrations are rejected.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

targetRankId.description: BeltRank id the exam promotes to (must be an active rank).

registrationDeadline.description: Registration deadline (ISO 8601); must not be after the exam date.

status.description: Lifecycle: DRAFT → OPEN → CLOSED → COMPLETED, or CANCELLED. Registration requires OPEN.

studentId.description: The student to register; must pass the ownership guard (self for STUDENT, verified link for PARENT).

status.description: RESULT_PASS promotes the student to the exam target rank; RESULT_FAIL leaves the belt unchanged.

resultNote.description: Examiner note recorded with the result.

examinerId.description: ADMIN only: attribute the result to another examiner (user id). Defaults to the caller.

inviteCode.description: The 8-character single-use invite code the club handed to the parent.

studentId.description: A verified PARENT grants on behalf of a linked MINOR (with an account). Omitted when the account holder consents for themselves. Idempotent when an active grant already exists.

purpose.description: Consent purpose to revoke (stamps the active row; history is kept).

studentId.description: Revoke on behalf of a linked minor; omitted for self.

body.example: CLB nghỉ các ngày 1-2/9. Các lớp học lại bình thường từ 3/9.

audience.description: ALL = whole club (ADMIN only); CLASS = one class only. Instructors may only post CLASS.

classId.description: Target class for audience=CLASS (required; instructors must teach it); forbidden when audience=ALL.

audience.description: New audience; switching to ALL clears the class target (instructors cannot switch to ALL).

classId.description: New target class; must be consistent with the effective audience.

studentId.description: StudentProfile who will miss the session; ownership guard applies (self/linked child).

classId.description: Class whose session will be missed; the student must be actively enrolled.

sessionDate.description: Date of the class session the student will miss (ISO date); must be today or later, and one request per (student, class, date).

status.description: Review outcome; only PENDING requests can be reviewed.

note.description: Reviewer note recorded with the decision.
note.example: Approved — have fun at the event

studentId.description: StudentProfile to propose; ownership guard applies (instructors: own-class students only).

proposedRankId.description: BeltRank id proposed; must be an active rank strictly above the student current rank. Advisory only — approval never moves the belt.

note.description: Motivation shown to the master when reviewing.
note.example: Consistent training, ready for the exam

note.description: Replacement note; only the author (or an admin) may edit while PENDING.

status.description: Master decision; only PENDING proposals can be reviewed.

studentId.description: StudentProfile being evaluated; ownership guard applies.

classId.description: Optional class context of the evaluation.

periodMonth.description: Period bucket month (1..12); both month and year must be given together.

periodYear.description: Period bucket year (2000..2100); both month and year must be given together.

comment.description: Free-text comment shown to the student and their parents.
comment.example: Strong progress on đòn thế; keep the guard up

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds; null when unranked.

phone.description: Contact phone. Hidden from instructors; present for admin/student/parent views.

emergencyContactName.description: Emergency contact person. Hidden from instructors.

emergencyContactPhone.description: Emergency contact phone. Hidden from instructors.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes; visible to every role for safety.
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

hasLinkedAccount.description: Whether the profile is linked to a loginable STUDENT account. Absent on instructor views.

inviteCode.description: Single-use parent invite code; returned only by student creation and invite regeneration.

effectiveTo.description: Last date the slot applies; null when open-ended.

instructorId.description: User id of the assigned instructor.

capacity.description: Maximum number of active enrollments; null when unbounded.

activeEnrollmentCount.description: Currently active enrollments; present on the class detail endpoint only.

leftAt.description: When the student left (soft leave); null while enrolled.

sessionDate.description: Session date (one per class per date).

instructorId.description: User id of the teacher of record.

fullName.description: Student full name (present when records are listed).

orderIndex.description: Global ordering; promotion always targets a higher order.

isActive.description: Deactivated ranks cannot be exam/proposal targets.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

capacity.description: Maximum active registrations; null when unbounded.

registrationDeadline.description: Registration cutoff; later registrations are rejected.

registeredCount.description: Active (non-cancelled) registrations; present on the detail endpoint only.

items.description: Line items; present on the detail/create endpoints only.

orderRef.description: Transfer content reference (VV + 8 chars); the webhook reconciles on it.

paidAt.description: When the payment succeeded; null while pending.

expiresAt.description: QR expiry (30 minutes); settlement can still arrive later.

note.description: Cash note or gateway mismatch detail.

percentOff.description: Percent discount when the code is percent-based.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount when the code is amount-based (VND integer).

payload.description: Template payload (e.g. {message}); render the message from this.

readAt.description: When the user marked it read; null while unread.

consentedByUserId.description: Acting parent when granted on behalf of a minor; null for self-consent.

alreadyActive.description: True when the grant was idempotent (an active grant already existed).

classId.description: Target class when audience=CLASS; null when club-wide.

sessionDate.description: Session date that will be missed.

note.example: Consistent training, ready for the exam

periodMonth.description: Period bucket month; null when the evaluation is not period-bound.

periodYear.description: Period bucket year; null when the evaluation is not period-bound.

comment.description: Comment shown to the student and their parents.

lastActiveAt.description: Last activity seen for the session.

accessToken.description: JWT access token; send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; rotate via POST /auth/refresh-token.

sessionId.description: Session created by this login (manageable under GET /auth/sessions).
